contract_toolchain_dependency_vulnerabil.scope: Ganache development and local test toolchain; not deployed contract bytecode

accepted_findings.reason: Owner-only withdrawal sends to the Safe owner after state-independent amount capture and is protected by ReentrancyGuard; failure reverts.
Timestamps enforce signed-claim expiry and the two-day signer activation delay; neither controls randomness, pricing, or winner selection.

notes: Compilation and all nine local launch-contract tests pass after the static-analysis hardening changes.
The website production dependency audit reports zero vulnerabilities.
Slither reports zero untriaged first-party findings after filtering OpenZeppelin dependencies and documenting two intentional patterns.
The Ganache findings remain isolated to the local development dependency tree and are not included in deployed bytecode.
An independent human contract review is still required before mainnet deployment.
